comment: Smitty.cpp:57-61 resets the oscillator state and sets epsilon to zero on any change of frequency, so while a V/OCT input is moving the module outputs five times the sine of a constant rather than a swept tone; it settles as soon as the pitch is held. With the shape CV patched the knob acts as its attenuator, so at a knob setting of zero the jack has no effect at all.
